basis.governing_question: How can MetalCo sell directly to small and mid-size contractors in Portugal and Spain through an online marketplace without losing its regional distributors?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the marketplace blueprint for small and mid-size contractors and how regional distributors fit, and plan the pilot.

gate.label: Go/no-go on pilot
gate.decision: Launch the pilot in one region on this blueprint?

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective_one_line: Launch a first marketplace version to contractors in one region and track repeat orders and distributor contract status.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Are the pilot evidence and scale-up case ready to take into the 2027 budget round?

workstreams.name: Marketplace hypotheses
workstreams.answers: Which hypotheses on the marketplace blueprint and the distributors' role must the design test?
activities: Interview the CEO, Head of Sales and distributors council
Review order data from the existing B2B ordering portal
Draft hypotheses on each blueprint component

workstreams.name: Contractor buying needs
workstreams.answers: How do small and mid-size contractors in Portugal and Spain buy today, and what would make them order online?
activities: Interview contractors in both countries on how they buy
Analyze warehouse order data by customer size
Review marketplaces already serving contractors

workstreams.name: Distributor role and terms
workstreams.answers: Where would the marketplace overlap with regional distributors, and what role keeps them committed?
activities: Interview distributors and the distributors council
Map where contractor demand overlaps distributor sales
Review distributor contracts for affected terms

workstreams.name: Blueprint and pilot plan
workstreams.answers: What marketplace blueprint do the tested hypotheses support, and how would a one-region pilot run?
activities: Draft the blueprint with tested hypotheses
Test a wireframe prototype with contractors
Plan the pilot region, scope and launch steps

workstreams.name: Pilot contractor group
workstreams.answers: Which small and mid-size contractors in the pilot region should be the first group to use the marketplace?
activities: Analyze order data for contractor groups in the region
Interview contractors and distributors in the region
Agree the first contractor group with the Head of Sales

workstreams.name: Pilot KPIs and distributors
workstreams.answers: Which KPIs do the stakeholders agree on, and how do repeat orders and distributor contract status develop?
activities: Agree the KPIs with each stakeholder group
Track repeat orders from contractors in operational data
Track distributor contract status and hear their concerns

workstreams.name: Marketplace first version
workstreams.answers: Can a first marketplace version be built and launched to a small group of contractors in one region?
activities: Build the first marketplace version from the blueprint
Prepare the readiness review for the first workshop
Launch after the workshop and fix issues from live use

workstreams.name: Pilot evidence and scale-up
workstreams.answers: What does scaling beyond the pilot region require, and is the evidence ready for the 2027 budget round?
activities: Synthesize order data and interviews against the criteria
Draft the scale-up business case and roadmap
Prepare the evidence for the final readout

deliverables.name: Contractor buying findings for Portugal and Spain
Distributor overlap map and contract terms review
Blueprint with tested hypotheses and wireframe prototype
First contractor target group in the pilot region
Pilot KPIs agreed with stakeholder groups
First-wave report on repeat orders and distributors
Pilot record of repeat orders and distributor status
Readiness review for the first marketplace version
First marketplace version and launch record
Updated marketplace version with live-use issue log
Pilot evidence synthesis against success criteria

events.label: Kick-off
events.decision: Confirm the scope, team and calendar for the design phase?
agenda: Present the engagement scope, phases and 20-week calendar
Review the success criteria for the pilot
Confirm client team, roles and meeting dates

events.label: Check-in: design findings
events.purpose: Review design findings before blueprint work
events.decision: Take these hypotheses and findings forward into blueprint design?
agenda: Review hypotheses on each blueprint component
Present contractor buying findings for Portugal and Spain
Discuss the distributor overlap map and contract terms

events.label: Go/no-go on pilot
events.purpose: Decide on pilot launch from the blueprint
events.decision: Launch the pilot in one region on this blueprint?
agenda: Present the blueprint, wireframe prototype and pilot plan
Review the hypotheses, buying findings and distributor terms behind it
Decide whether to launch the pilot in one region

events.label: Workshop 1: pilot readiness
events.purpose: Check readiness before the first go-live
events.decision: Is the first marketplace version ready to go live with this group and these KPIs?
agenda: Review the readiness of the first marketplace version
Present the first contractor target group and pilot KPIs
Discuss open readiness points before go-live

events.label: Workshop 2: first wave
events.purpose: Review first-wave results and scale-up basis
events.decision: Confirm the first-wave evidence as the basis for the scale-up case?
agenda: Present the first-wave report on repeat orders and distributors
Review the first marketplace version and its launch record
Discuss what the evidence so far means for the scale-up case

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Close the pilot and prepare the budget round
events.decision: Are the pilot evidence and scale-up case ready to take into the 2027 budget round?
agenda: Present the pilot evidence synthesis against the success criteria
Review the pilot record, updated version and scale-up case with roadmap
Decide if the evidence is ready for the 2027 budget round

architect_notes: The 20 weeks are stated; the 6-week Design and 14-week Pilot split is an estimate based on archetype lengths and time to repeat orders.
No Implementation phase: the marketplace is new, so the plan stops at the pilot; the rollout after it is not in these phases.
No Measurement phase: the brief's repeat-order and distributor criteria are tracked inside the Pilot, because 20 weeks leave no separate post-launch stage.
Not covered by the phases: European Commission, digital product passports under the Construction Products Regulation. Confirm whether it is in scope.
